# CANDIDATE: RIBBON_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A tightly contracted EMA ribbon signals low volatility; a breakout in the direction of the prior close captures the ensuing expansion. This trades the breakout from a compressed ribbon, which is absent from the registry and killed list.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: When the ribbon width (max EMA − min EMA of the 8,13,21,34 EMA) is <0.15×ATR(14) for two consecutive 5‑minute bars and the second bar’s close is above the highest EMA (long) or below the lowest EMA (short), enter at the open of the next bar in that direction. Exit shape: Initial stop at the opposite ribbon extreme (below lowest EMA for long, above highest EMA for short); target at 2×ATR or a trailing chandelier exit. Regime hint: VIX between 12‑22 and time after 10:00 to avoid opening noise; skip major economic releases.
